**Finding: MISSING** (confidence 0.9)

The agreement has no exit provision at all. § 3.5 "Effect of Termination" covers only accrued payment obligations, and document-wide searches for *transition*, *return*, *export*, *delete/destroy* and *migrate* returned no hits. The nearby candidates don't help: § 11.6 makes us solely responsible for our own Content, § 14.18 covers only contact-information processing, and § 14.2 simply lists 3.5 among surviving terms — surviving a clause that says nothing about data return.

Because IBM hosts our Content, this falls short of even the fallback position (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export) and edges toward walk-away territory, since nothing obliges IBM to give our data back on exit.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** inserted a new paragraph after p0049 in § 3.5 at the preferred position — (a) up to six months' transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates on request, (b) return/export of all Content and Customer data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and (c) deletion thereafter with written certification. The clause is drafted to cover termination of the Agreement or any individual Service Option Attachment, matching the document's structure, and the 90-day fallback is offered in the comment.
